purpose: Test whether preserving the exact two-moment cancellation of each retained hat edge creates a genuine conductor saving before any Cauchy or absolute-value step.

parent_boundary.fixed_branch: positive DPA for the retained adjacent-gap hat

exact_object.edge: A retained adjacent-prime log edge e=[a,b] with physical gap at most Y^(161/1000).
exact_object.defect: D_e = alpha_e delta_a + beta_e delta_b - phi(u)1_[a,b](u)du, where alpha_e and beta_e are the exact barycentric hat integrals on that edge.
identities: the retained atomic measure minus its retained continuous comparator is the normalized sum of the D_e
exact_object.quantifiers: Every sufficiently large admissible half-integer Y; the actual consecutive-prime edges and their exact weights; all t in [Y^(839/1000),2Y^(50/33)].

numerical_criterion.acceptable_partial_gain: An exact selector-preserving transformation followed by published estimates that lowers the generic Y^2 conductor by a fixed positive power, with every exponent recorded.
numerical_criterion.nonresult: A formal coboundary identity with derivatives costing back the same power, a coefficient-uniform large sieve, or a conjectural randomness assertion.

breadth_routes.harmonic_analysis: Peano kernels, compactly supported wavelets with two vanishing moments, square functions, almost orthogonality, and time-frequency tiles.
breadth_routes.analytic_number_theory: Delta/circle dispersion, determinant offsets, bilinear Kloosterman forms, prime-pair selectors, and shifted-convolution main-term subtraction.
breadth_routes.probability_combinatorics: Barycentric random rounding, degenerate U-statistics, Hoeffding projections, additive energy of prime logs, and point-process structure factors.

licensed_falsifiers.abstract: Odd-half-grid or phase-aligned edge systems have the same two local moments and can retain a constant high-frequency peak; vanishing moments alone cannot suffice.
licensed_falsifiers.fejer: Any positivity or absolute close-pair replacement restores the generic conductor term.
licensed_falsifiers.prime_density_pseudonodes: Coarse density, gap bounds, and exact edge centering survive hostile pseudo-prime constructions; actual arithmetic must enter the residual estimate.
licensed_falsifiers.finite: The four frozen scales are twin-edge-only and may check identities or morphology, not asymptotic saving.

hard_stop: The edge representation is collapsed back to arbitrary endpoint coefficients before its zero and first moments are used.
Integration by parts spends at least the full gain through powers of t or B.
A cited theorem does not accept next-prime/consecutive-gap coefficients with the required uniform quantifiers.
The proposed mechanism also proves the hostile half-grid case.
The residual statement is merely GCG4 under a new name.
decision_rule: Continue only if at least one route produces a smaller norm or transform with a verified fixed-power advantage and a theorem-compatible coefficient class. Otherwise record why breadth does not bridge the missing arithmetic input.
